defect.cause: The canonical HUD waits for ToyWarsStatus after leaderstats arrives, but WorkshopQueueNotice still says 'Waiting for a free workshop slot...' until every status value replicates. This falsely describes an already allocated player as queued during status replication lag.
defect.reproduction: Run the entire canonical HUD LocalScript through the new Lua fixture. Assert that the queue notice is visible before leaderstats, then inspect the same notice at ToyWarsStatus:WaitForChild. Removing the new text transition from the complete script reproduces the stale queue message.

fix: After leaderstats arrives, change the still-visible notice to 'Preparing your workshop...' while ToyWarsStatus/values replicate. Hide it and show the existing three selectors and first-play guide only after readiness. No gameplay remote commands are added.
character_impact: PON/GUARDON/TANKURU/JUNK stats, costs, attacks, visuals and selection command behavior unchanged; only the interim HUD notice text changes.

tests.negative_control: Complete canonical HUD source with only the new text transition removed; must reproduce the stale queue message.

evidence.main_qa_note: Both jobs succeeded at 654850d7; current main 340afc57 is its generated status-only descendant.

next_action: Create draft PR and require latest-head offline and compile_hold success; independent REVIEWER alone may merge. Actual Roblox replication timing, mobile touch and visual UX remain untested.
